purpose: Operational PAPER validation only. Probe eligibility uses high pre-calibration candidate confidence and now also requires the same fresh institutional decision-data gate consumed by pre-trade risk before a probe can enter the queue. This cannot authorize broker connectivity, live order transmission or movement of real capital.
approvalReference: Operator instruction on 2026-09-24 to continue Fenice. V5 corrects a staging/execution gate mismatch discovered in v4: Committee/Terminal evidence could stage a probe while the freshly rebuilt institutional intelligence had already fallen below the execution threshold, causing a safe but wasteful RISK_REJECTED attempt.
notes: V5 keeps every v4 economic and safety limit unchanged. Before writing a validation order to the PAPER queue, the staging wrapper must pass the canonical fresh decision-data gate: critical sources fresh GREEN, institutional confidence >=90, at least 10 cross-source checks, zero divergence, concentration <=50%, at least three market sources and three asset classes, and the configured timestamp freshness policy. Candidate selection still uses pre-calibration data confidence >=90 so immature calibration cannot deadlock sample creation. Every staged probe must still pass committee score >=70, risk <=75, permitted decision/currency, market-data quorum, portfolio risk, pre-trade risk, kill switch, audit and reconciliation. Probe size remains EUR 250-300 equivalent, at most 3% of EUR capital and 15% single-asset ceiling, maximum one probe per UTC day and twenty total attempts for ten target fills. LIVE and broker connectivity remain forbidden.
